programs.title: B.Tech
programs.description: The Bachelor's of Technology in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (B.Tech in EEE) is a four-year undergraduate program that delves into the design, analysis, and application of electrical and electronic systems. Students gain expertise in power generation and distribution, circuit design, electronics, and control systems.

programs.title: M.Tech
programs.description: The M.Tech. programme in Electrical Drives and Control is designed to provide students with a thorough understanding of both theoretical and practical aspects of electrical drives and control systems. It aims to equip them with advanced skills required for pursuing research in the field...
